command: node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run tests/integration/http.test.ts -t "completes a real HTTP request"
targetTest: completes a real HTTP request after its body has been fully read
expected: A complete JSON POST over a real loopback connection returns HTTP 200 with the shared successful result
actual: The adapter returned HTTP 499 because its eager Fastify request.signal subscription treated normal IncomingMessage completion as client cancellation
output: AssertionError: expected 499 to be 200; expected: 200; received: 499
resolution: Use a request-scoped caller signal driven by incomplete request close or unfinished response close, with response-finish listener cleanup
